name.full: Zava One Company - News, knowledge, and connection

description.short: Company news, events, people, and trusted knowledge in your Teams personal app.
description.full: Your window into the company. Zava One Company brings the focused Company workspace into your Teams personal app, without a Company/Personal switcher. Discover company news, timely announcements, events, trusted knowledge, people, communities, and workplace information in one composed experience. This sample uses fictional Zava data and simulated actions for demonstrations; it does not connect to live employee records. Requires the Zava One SharePoint Framework solution to be deployed in your organization's SharePoint App Catalog.
